scientific_integrity: All infinite and all-parameter assertions follow from explicit scalar-root bijections, strict derivative signs, controlled inverse-frequency expansions, and hyperbolic persistence. Numerical checks are diagnostics only. Possible earlier equivalent scalar sine-map analyses remain a priority risk; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The complete fixed-point census concerns the positive net-gain half-space. Exact stable fixed-point windows are established on pure sine feedback, with local open-parameter persistence only; no global stability chart for arbitrary nonzero delay coefficients, no periodic-orbit or basin classification, and no nonlinear neutrality theorem.
title: Infinitely many fold-to-flip sink windows in a three-dimensional symmetric sine map
